svg.title: Demand, supply recommendations, and requirements
svg.desc: Demand, supply recommendations, and requirements. Which links are stored, and which are analytical planning context? Primary tables: DemandForecast, InventoryPolicy, SupplyPlanRecommendation, MaterialRequirementPlan, RoughCutCapacityPlan. Planning context is not a one-record foreign-key trace. Requisitions and work orders reference SupplyPlanRecommendationID when converted into execution documents.
